entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It just isn't what I thought it would be. It's confusing and kind of hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. Sometimes there's just a small learning curve. Did you get a chance to review the user manual that came with it?
I glanced at the user manual. It wasn't helpful. I just expected more from the device. I want to return it.
Okay, I understand. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility for you. Can you please provide the email address used for the purchase?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th, which was 33 days ago.
Let me check the policy. ... Yes, it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.

I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Simply print that out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it at any local post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Great. Should have been easier than this.
I do apologize for any inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
